origin.description: Poverty of an income vector under the Watts, Sen, SST, or Foster measure.
origin.usage: pov(x, k, parameter = NULL, type = c("Watts", "Sen", "SST", "Foster"), na.rm = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Income vector. The measures are defined for non-negative values.

arguments.name: k
arguments.text: Absolute poverty line, a single constant.

arguments.name: parameter
arguments.text: Parameter of the chosen measure. NULL keeps the default of that measure.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Which measure to compute: Watts, Sen, SST, or Foster. A unique prefix is enough. Defaults to Watts.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If true, drop missing values before computing. If false, any missing value makes the result missing.

origin.details: pov dispatches to Watts, Sen, SST, and Foster (Foster, Greer, and Thorbecke). A NULL parameter is resolved inside the chosen measure. Foster with parameter 1 is the headcount ratio, and with parameter 2 the poverty gap ratio.
origin.value: A single number, the poverty measure.
origin.example:
# generate vectors (of incomes)
x <- c(541, 1463, 2445, 3438, 4437, 5401, 6392, 8304, 11904, 22261)
y <- c(841, 2063, 2445, 3438, 4437, 5401, 6392, 8304, 11304, 21961)
# compute Watts index with poverty line 2000
pov(x, 2000)
pov(y, 2000)
# compute headcount ratio with poverty line 2000
pov(x, 2000, parameter=1, type="Foster")
pov(y, 2000, parameter=1, type="Foster")

translation.description: Poverty of an income vector under the Watts, Sen, SST, or Foster measure.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Income vector. The measures are defined for non-negative values. Missing values are NaN.

arguments.name: k
arguments.text: Absolute poverty line, a single constant.

arguments.name: parameter
arguments.text: Passed through to Foster. None keeps Foster's default of 1. Watts, Sen, and SST do not use it.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Watts, Sen, SST, or Foster. A unique prefix is enough, so "F" is Foster and "SS" is SST. An unknown or ambiguous name raises ValueError. Defaults to Watts.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If true, drop missing values before computing. If false, any missing value makes the result NaN.

translation.details: pov dispatches to Watts, Sen, SST, and Foster. parameter is passed through, so pov(x, k, type="Foster") matches Foster(x, k). Foster with parameter 1 is the headcount ratio, and with parameter 2 the poverty gap ratio. type follows R prefix matching: only a unique prefix is accepted.
translation.value: A single number, the poverty measure.
translation.example:
from ineq.poverty import pov

# generate vectors (of incomes)
x = [541, 1463, 2445, 3438, 4437, 5401, 6392, 8304, 11904, 22261]
y = [841, 2063, 2445, 3438, 4437, 5401, 6392, 8304, 11304, 21961]
# compute Watts index with poverty line 2000
print(pov(x, 2000))
print(pov(y, 2000))
# compute headcount ratio with poverty line 2000
print(pov(x, 2000, parameter=1, type="Foster"))
print(pov(y, 2000, parameter=1, type="Foster"))
